source.method: Projected the outdoor map into local metres. Road vertices retain shared OSM IDs. Road widths and building heights are estimates where OSM has no measurements. Plazas, parking and mapped courtyards retain their outlines. Topology follows the source and no link is inferred from overlapping lines at different heights.
source.imagery: The 3D campus is reconstructed from geographic data and available visual references. This dataset does not establish NAVER panorama coverage.
source.carAccess: Driving follows connected outdoor motor streets, service roads and surface parking. Visitor/customer and destination-only roads admit cars approaching the facility. Walks, trails, steps, cycleways, sidewalks, lawns and pedestrian plazas are scenery. Private, permit-only, emergency-only and conditional vehicle access are excluded. Mapped physical blockers and actual gates retain their restrictions. In Campus Drive the 72 m photographed Kaimaru frontage from Oreum-gil to the west gate is open as a game exception. OSM marks both real-world gates motor_vehicle=no.
